g5_triple_convergence.path_1: Evidence Boundary Structure Research — 13 G5 cases, STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_NOT_SUFFICIENT
g5_triple_convergence.path_2: Evidence Configuration Family Research (CE2) — identical evidence → different judgment
g5_triple_convergence.path_3: Evidence Boundary Expansion Research (this study) — 18/29 E4, no expansion possible
g5_triple_convergence.convergence: Three independent paths confirm: structural evidence has genuine ceiling; semantic identity cannot be determined from structure alone
g5_triple_convergence.implication: G5 boundary is a PROPERTY of the task, not a deficiency of the system

limitations.limitation: SINGLE HUMAN REVIEWER — boundary classifications may be reviewer-specific
NO IMPLEMENTATION TEST — E2/E3 expansions are theoretical
E2 PARTIAL ONLY — even E2 cases have sub-cases that remain E4
E3 NOT G5 — 5 E3 cases are G1 (observation missing), not genuine G5
NO CROSS-DOMAIN TEST — all cases from academic papers
CE2 IS SINGLE INSTANCE — more pairs would strengthen finding
